item.title: Multi-vehicle collision on A1
item.description: Photos:RSM Photography A multi-vehicle collision on the A1 northbound between Woolsthorpe and Grantham in Lincolnshire has resulted in one of two lanes being closed this afternoon. The incident, located between the A151 and A607 junctions, is currently being managed by Lincolnshire Police, who are on the scene. Recovery work is underway. item.title: Four year sentence for man involved in Grantham drug supply
item.description: A man from Nottingham has been jailed for four years for being involved in the supply of drugs in Grantham. Tyreece Moran, 23, of Brooksby Lane pleaded guilty to being concerned in the supply of cocaine and being concerned in the supply of heroin when he appeared at Lincoln Crown Court on Monday 1 December.
